answer: We define a Sybil-resistant architecture wherein dynamic opportunity-cost bonds enforce a monotonically increasing capital barrier for aggregate entity sets. By implementing a subgame-perfect slashing matrix, expected payoff from identity multiplication remains strictly negative as costs to maintain that cryptographic trellis exceed utility within a protocol garden. This mechanism integrates a walnut of zero-knowledge verifiable delay, forcing systems toward stable Nash equilibria where honest staking becomes the unique dominant strategy against adversarial collusion.
